_README: Hand-written weekly findings. This file is the one you edit.
A week listed here overrides the commit-message fallback.
Any week you leave out uses that week's latest commit as the summary
and its commit URL as the proof link.
week     plan week number (W1 = Monday 2026-09-07). Required.
summary  the week's new finding, one sentence. Required.
from/to  override the date range (ISO yyyy-mm-dd).
proof    { url, label, sha } - omit `url` to inherit that week's

events.summary: Vietnamese NER was benchmarked across four VLSP campaigns and grew from 3 to 40 entity categories, yet no campaign includes a statutory personal-data identifier type.
events.detail: Strongest single piece of evidence for G1a: the field had ample opportunity and still did not cover CCCD / MST / BHXH / plates. Also restated the gap as a falsifiable negative claim requiring a recorded search, not an assertion.
